After checking input+0x110, it obtains a record pointer, checks a bounded index/value condition, validates the indexed candidate, then calls set_attribute_record_byte_0x3c_indexed. The direct caller passes value 4 and its loop index as arguments, supporting the conditional indexed setter wording. Source: decompiled/main/main_0052.c:17204-17244, decompiled/main/main_0052.c:15247-15253.

The body conditionally reads and combines property-27 values, invokes handlers using the global attribute-context entry, and always waits for entry processing before returning. No direct caller is indexed; the precise purpose of the combination/handler is unresolved, so leave unnamed. Source: decompiled/main/main_0087.c:37055-37085.

Queries attribute-context selector 0x13 and returns false when its value is 8. Otherwise it calls the global property-0 predicate f_7000eddaa4, whose body queries selector 0 and returns true exactly when that value is 1. This supports the conjunction name; no direct caller is indexed. Source: decompiled/main/main_0123.c:10918-10937, decompiled/main/main_0105.c:43408-43418.
